system.description: The flask contains a vile, roiling green liquid. Surely something fetid would be released should the flask be unstoppered. But the label appears to be legitimate, so perhaps everything will be just fine... Encumbrance: 1 If this flask is opened or shattered, it floods the area, extending a vile green cloud out to medium range. The cloud lasts for 3 rounds. Anyone in the cloud gains the Blinded condition until the end of the encounter and must make a Disease {Dc}2 check or gain a disease with the Exposure trait.
